name: redline
description: Ingests real-time UI comments from the Redline browser extension and exposes them to your AI coding assistant, which implements them directly and parks anything that needs a plan.

root.title: Project directory
root.description: The repository to write comments into (.redline/design-comments.json and screenshots land here; never committed).

port.title: Ingest port
port.description: Localhost port the browser extension posts to. Falls back to 7475/7476 if taken.

prompts.name: watch
prompts.description: Start Redline watch mode — bind a browser session and implement UI comments as they arrive.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List UI comments, optionally filtered by status.

tools.name: resolve_comment
tools.description: Set a comment's status to open, resolved, or wontfix.

tools.name: resolve_comments
tools.description: Resolve or wontfix multiple comments in one call.

tools.name: clear_resolved
tools.description: Remove every comment that is not open.

tools.name: wait_for_update
tools.description: Block until the store changes or a short timeout; heartbeats the session binding.

tools.name: bind_session
tools.description: Pair with the session id shown in the browser toolbar. Returns storeRoot, commentsPath, and watchProtocol.

tools.name: unbind_session
tools.description: Release session ownership when watch mode stops.

tools.name: defer_comment
tools.description: Park a comment for later planning; notifies the browser toolbar.

tools.name: list_deferred
tools.description: List comments that were deferred for planning.

tools.name: list_rating_requests
tools.description: List page rating requests (pending or scored).

tools.name: submit_rating
tools.description: Submit Awwwards-style UI/UX rating using the /redline-design-score skill; falls back to own judgment when the skill is unavailable.
